events.title: Industry City Gourmet Food and Drinks Tour
events.description:
Set against the iconic backdrop of Sunset Park’s historic waterfront, the massive, revitalized structures of Industry City form a breathtaking stage for an exclusive culinary journey. This premium food and cocktail tour is a curated exploration of taste and craft, transforming an evening into a memorable, high-end experience.
Your adventure begins with artistic bonbons at Lilac Chocolates, explores gourmet imports at Sahadi’s, and includes a refined whiskey tasting at Fort Hamilton Distillery, followed by a sophisticated sake flight. Savor additional artisanal discoveries within the awe-inspiring industrial halls.
Perfect as a distinctive date night, this tour is also fully customizable for private groups and corporate retreats. We specialize in tailoring this engaging experience for team-building and client entertainment, making it an ideal one-day corporate outing. A sophisticated mini-vacation for locals and a profound discovery for visitors.

events.title: Dried Flower Resin Ornament Making Workshop Hosted by little bloomtale × KAJIHA
events.description:
Join us for a fun and creative Dried Flower Resin Craft Workshop at Makers Guild, Industry City!
Discover the art of preserving beautiful dried flowers in resin and create your own unique keepsake this holiday season. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing creative activity, a fun weekend experience, or a special handmade gift, this workshop is the perfect opportunity to try something new.
Guided by the talented KAJIHA florist and creative team, you’ll learn how to select and arrange dried flowers, pour resin, and design your very own beautiful ornament in a welcoming and friendly environment.
No prior experience is necessary! Just bring your creativity and enjoy the process.
*What You’ll Create
• One custom-designed dried flower resin piece of your choice: an ornament, necklace, bracelet, or keychain.
*What’s Included
• Dried flower materials
• Decorative ribbon
• Hanging string
• Materials and supplies for one resin ornament or jewelry
Celebrate the holiday season with flowers, creativity, and a little hands-on fun. Create a beautiful handmade keepsake to cherish or gift to someone special!
*By Appointment Only
Please register in advance on the KAJIHA website before visiting.
Spaces are limited. Sign up now and join us for a creative holiday experience!
